about: Regal Rexnord is a Milwaukee-based industrial manufacturer, listed on the NYSE (RRX), making electric motors, power transmission, bearings and automation components for HVAC, aerospace, agriculture, and automotive customers. Created by the 2021 merger of Regal Beloit and Rexnord's PMC business. Revenue is about $6 billion. B2B with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Regal Rexnord
wiki.text: Regal Rexnord Corporation is a manufacturer of electric motors and power transmission components based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company has manufacturing, sales, and service facilities throughout the United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, and Asia, with about 29,000 employees. One of the largest electric motor manufacturers in the world, its Genteq brand brushless DC electric motors are found in almost all variable speed residential HVAC equipment in the United States today, and its GE Commercial Motors, Leeson, and Marathon Electric Motor brands are used throughout the industrial sector. As of 2021, the company is ranked 763rd on the For

about: Olam Agri is the food, feed and fibre business of Olam Group, based in Singapore, trading and processing grains, rice, edible oils, flour and cotton, and selling packaged staple foods to consumers in Africa. Saudi Arabia's SALIC bought a major stake (about 44 percent) in 2022. Customers are food manufacturers, farmers and consumers across emerging markets. Strong staple food brands in Africa, but little visibility in the main F1 markets.
cb_desc: Olam Agri offers food, feed and fibre in high-growth emerging....

about: International Holding Company (IHC) is Abu Dhabi's largest publicly listed holding company, with interests across more than 1,000 subsidiaries in healthcare, real estate, food and agriculture, utilities, construction, finance, technology and mining. Group names include Ghitha, Alpha Dhabi, Aldar stakes, Easy Lease, 2PointZero and Palms Sports. It has market capitalisation above 200 billion dollars and is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (IHC), chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed. Large corporate brand, with some presence in sports and entertainment.

wiki.title: International Holding Company
wiki.what: Holding company in the United Arab Emirates
wiki.text: The International Holding Company (IHC) is a holding company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, which manages a diversified portfolio of domestic and foreign investments. Royal Group, owned by the Abu Dhabi ruling dynasty, is the biggest shareholder at 61%. IHC´s chairman is Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed al-Nahyan, who also serves as the country's National Security Advisor and manages two sovereign wealth funds. The company is listed on the Abu Dhabi stock exchange and as of 2024 had a market capitalization of 240 billion US dollar. After the Royal Group transferred 40 companies worth US$4.7 billion to IHC, the company's share price

about: Mowi is the world's largest producer of farmed Atlantic salmon, headquartered in Bergen, Norway. It runs hatcheries, sea farms, feed production and processing plants across Norway, Scotland, Canada, Chile, Ireland, the Faroe Islands and Iceland, selling fresh and value-added salmon products to supermarkets, food service and distributors in about 70 markets. Revenue is around EUR 5 billion and it employs over 11,000 people. Listed on Oslo Bors (MOWI). Consumer-facing branded products in Europe such as Mowi retail packs, though the company is largely a B2B supplier.

wiki.title: Mowi
wiki.text: Mowi ASA (), known as Marine Harvest ASA until 2019 and as Pan Fish until 2007, is a Norwegian seafood company with operations in a number of countries around the world. The company's primary interest is fish farming, primarily salmon, the operations of which are focused on Norway, Scotland, Canada, the Faroe Islands, Ireland and Chile. The group has a share of 25 to 30% of the global salmon and trout market, making it the world's largest company in the sector. Mowi also owns a 'value added processing' unit, which prepares and distributes a range of seafood products, and a number of smaller divisions. The company assumed its current form as a

about: Olam International is a Singapore-based agri-business and food ingredients group, founded in 1989, trading and processing cocoa, coffee, cashews, spices, dairy, edible nuts, cotton and grains. Since 2022 it has operated through Olam Food Ingredients (ofi) and Olam Agri, with Saudi Arabia's SALIC buying a majority of Olam Agri. Customers are food, beverage and consumer goods manufacturers in around 60 countries, with revenue above $40 billion. Temasek's Aranda is the largest shareholder and the shares are listed on the SGX. B2B supplier with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Olam International
wiki.what: Nigerian agriculture company listed in SGX
wiki.text: Olam International is a Nigerian-founded agri-business company, operating in 60 countries and supplying food and industrial raw materials to over 20,900 customers worldwide, placing them among the world's largest suppliers of cocoa beans, coffee, cotton and rice. Its value chain includes farming, origination, processing and distribution operations, child labor, and allegedly even child slavery.

about: Syngenta Group is a Swiss-headquartered agricultural technology group based in Basel, wholly owned by state-owned Sinochem Holdings of China since the 2017 acquisition of Syngenta AG for $43 billion. It sells crop protection chemicals, seeds, digital farming tools and, via Adama and Syngenta Group China, a wide agricultural portfolio to farmers and distributors in over 100 countries. Revenue is about $28 billion. An IPO on the Shanghai STAR Market was withdrawn in 2024. B2B agricultural brand, high recognition among farmers and limited among consumers.

wiki.title: Syngenta
wiki.what: Global provider of agricultural science and technology
wiki.text: Syngenta AG is a global agricultural technology company headquartered in Basel, Switzerland. It primarily covers crop protection and seeds for farmers. Syngenta is part of the Syngenta Group, entirely owned by Sinochem, a Chinese state-owned enterprise. Syngenta was founded in 2000 by the merger of the agrichemical businesses of Novartis and AstraZeneca, and acquired by China National Chemical Corporation (ChemChina) in 2017. In 2020, the Syngenta Group was formed, bringing together Syngenta (Syngenta Crop Protection and Syngenta Seeds), Adama, and the agricultural business of Sinochem, now called Syngenta Group China, under a single entity.

about: Corteva Agriscience is a US agricultural company based in Indianapolis, created in 2019 when DowDuPont split its agriculture arm. It sells corn and soybean seeds under the Pioneer and Brevant brands, and crop protection products such as herbicides, insecticides and biologicals, to farmers and distributors in over 140 countries. Revenue is around $16-17 billion. Listed on the NYSE under CTVA, and in 2025 it announced plans to separate its seed and crop protection businesses. Strong brand with farmers, almost no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Corteva
wiki.text: Corteva, Inc. (also known as Corteva Agriscience) is an American company devoted to products for seeds and crop protection, including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biologicals (natural herbicides) that are sold in 110 countries. The company's name combines "cor" (Latin for "heart") with "teva" (the Hebrew word for nature). It is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Its primary brand is Pioneer Hi-Bred International.

about: John Deere (Deere & Company) is the world's largest agricultural machinery maker, based in Moline, Illinois, founded in 1837. It sells tractors, combines, sprayers, construction and forestry equipment and lawn and turf products, plus precision agriculture technology and John Deere Financial, to farmers, contractors and dealers worldwide. Revenue is around $45-55 billion depending on the year. Listed on the NYSE under DE. The green-and-yellow brand is a household name in the US and in rural markets, with a strong global dealer network.

wiki.title: John Deere
wiki.what: American agricultural and industrial auto manufacturing corporation
wiki.text: Deere & Company (doing business as John Deere) (), is an American corporation that manufactures agricultural machinery, heavy equipment, forestry machinery, diesel engines, drivetrains (axles, transmissions, gearboxes) used in heavy equipment and lawn care equipment. It also provides financial services and other related activities. Deere & Company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol DE. The company's slogan is "Nothing Runs Like a Deere", and its logo is a leaping deer with the words "John Deere". It has used logos incorporating a leaping deer for over 155 years. It is headquartered in Moline, Illinois. It ranked No. 84

about: ICL Group is an Israeli global specialty minerals and chemicals company, based in Tel Aviv and listed on the NYSE and Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (ICL), producing potash, phosphates, bromine, magnesium and specialty fertilisers, plus food, industrial and flame-retardant ingredients from the Dead Sea and mines in Spain, the UK and elsewhere. Customers are agriculture and industrial firms worldwide. It employs around 12,000 people. B2B brand with a modest consumer profile.

Glencore is one of the world's largest commodity producers and traders, based in Baar, Switzerland, listed on the London Stock Exchange (GLEN), with mining operations in copper, cobalt, nickel, zinc and coal, plus oil trading and agricultural products through Viterra. It employs well over 100,000 people including contractors and sells to industrial buyers, utilities and manufacturers. B2B commodity group, with limited consumer awareness; coal and oil exposure may raise sponsorship sensitivities.

wiki.title: Glencore
wiki.what: Multinational commodity trading and mining company
wiki.text: Glencore plc is an Anglo-Swiss multinational commodity trading and mining company with headquarters in Baar, Switzerland. Glencore's oil and gas headquarters are in London, England, as well as its primary listing being on the London Stock Exchange, and it is one of the largest components of the FTSE 100 by market capitalization. The company's registered office is in Saint Helier, Jersey, a Crown Dependency of the United Kingdom. By some estimates, it is the world's largest commodity trader, and among the world's largest companies. The company was formed in 1994 by a management buyout of Marc Rich + Co AG (itself founded in 1974). The company

about: Zoomlion is a major Chinese construction machinery maker, based in Changsha, Hunan, listed in Shenzhen and Hong Kong (1157), producing concrete machinery, mobile and tower cranes, earthmoving equipment, agricultural machines and aerial work platforms, sold to contractors worldwide. It is one of China's largest equipment makers, with overseas sales and a growing international presence. Revenue is from machinery sales and leasing. B2B industrial brand, with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Zoomlion
wiki.what: Chinese construction and agricultural machinery manufacturer
wiki.text: Zoomlion Heavy Industry Science and Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese construction machinery and agricultural machinery manufacturer. Its headquarters are in the Zoomlion Science Park in Changsha, Hunan, China. Zoomlion is China's largest and world's fifth largest construction machinery enterprise.

about: ARAUCO is a Chilean forestry and wood products company, based in Santiago, which produces pulp, sawn timber, wood panels and bioenergy from its plantations in Chile, Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay, with plants also in North America. Customers are construction, furniture and packaging industries, and it exports worldwide. It is a subsidiary of the Chilean conglomerate Empresas Copec. Crunchbase shows about 2.7 billion dollars of funding. B2B industrial brand with strong recognition in Chile.

OCP Group is Morocco's state-owned phosphate and fertiliser giant, based in Casablanca, which mines phosphate rock and produces phosphoric acid and fertilisers, exporting to farmers across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas. Its Morocco-based reserves are among the world's largest. It has tens of thousands of employees and revenue of around 9 billion dollars. Owned by the Moroccan state. Crunchbase shows about 2.75 billion dollars of funding. B2B industrial brand with strong national recognition in Morocco and visible sports sponsorships.

wiki.title: OCP Group
wiki.text: OCP Group, formerly Office Chérifien des Phosphates, is a Moroccan state-owned phosphate rock miner, phosphoric acid manufacturer and fertilizer producer. Founded in 1920, the company has grown to become the world's largest producer of phosphate and phosphate-based products and it is one of the largest phosphate, fertilizer, chemicals, and mineral industrial companies in the world by revenue. OCP has access to more than 70% of the world's phosphate rock reserves. Initially a mining company, OCP diversified in 1965 to become a phosphate processor, making it the world's largest fertilizer manufacturer. The company holds a 31% market share of th

about: Dow is a US materials science giant based in Midland, Michigan, listed on the NYSE (DOW) since its 2019 spin-off from DowDuPont. It makes plastics such as polyethylene, packaging materials, industrial intermediates, coatings and silicones for packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer-care customers in over 100 countries. Revenue is around $43 billion with about 36,000 employees. B2B maker with strong corporate brand recognition and a long record in major sports sponsorship, including as a worldwide Olympic partner.

Yara International is a Norwegian crop nutrition company based in Oslo and listed on Euronext Oslo, with the Norwegian state as a major shareholder. It is one of the world's largest producers of nitrogen fertilisers and ammonia, along with industrial nitrogen products and digital farming tools, selling in more than 60 countries to farmers, distributors and industry. Revenue is around $14 billion to $15 billion with about 17,000 employees. B2B brand well known in agriculture.

wiki.title: Yara International
wiki.text: Yara International ASA is a Norwegian chemical company. It produces, distributes, and sells nitrogen-based mineral fertilizers and related industrial products. Its product line also includes phosphate and potash-based mineral fertilizers, as well as complex and specialty mineral fertilizer products. The company was established in 1905 as Norsk Hydro — the world's first producer of mineral nitrogen fertilizers — and de-merged as Yara International ASA on 25 March 2004. Yara is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and has its headquarters in Oslo. The company has more than 17,000 employees, production sites on six continents, operations in more th

about: Nigeria's largest industrial conglomerate, owned by Aliko Dangote, with businesses in cement (Dangote Cement, listed in Lagos), sugar refining, salt, flour, fertiliser, packaging and a large oil refinery and petrochemical complex at Lekki. It supplies basic consumer and construction goods across Nigeria and into other African countries, and earns money from product sales and exports. Headquartered in Lagos with tens of thousands of staff. The Dangote name is among the most visible commercial brands in Africa and the group sponsors football, boxing and charity events.

wiki.title: Dangote Group
wiki.text: The Dangote Group is a Nigerian multinational industrial conglomerate, founded by Aliko Dangote. It is the largest conglomerate in West Africa and one of the largest on the African continent. The group employs more than 30,000 people, and generated revenues of more than US$4.1 billion in 2017.

about: One of Japan's big five trading houses (sogo shosha), active in grain and food supply, power generation and infrastructure, metals, chemicals, aerospace and retail partnerships, with grain handling through Columbia Grain in the US. It profits from trading margins, project investments and equity earnings in dozens of countries. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8002) and partly held by Berkshire Hathaway. Large corporate with tens of thousands of staff; strong B2B name, modest consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Marubeni
wiki.text: Marubeni Corporation (丸紅株式会社, Marubeni Kabushiki-gaisha) (TYO: 8002, OSE: 8002, NSE: 8002) is a sōgō shōsha (general trading company) headquartered in Otemachi, Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan. It is one of the largest sogo shosha and has leading market shares in cereal and paper pulp trading as well as a strong electrical and industrial plant business. Marubeni is a member of the Fuyo keiretsu.

about: Trimble is a US technology company, based in Westminster, Colorado, that sells positioning, GPS, software and sensor systems. Its products serve construction (Tekla, SketchUp, machine control), geospatial surveying, agriculture and transportation fleets, sold to contractors, engineers, farmers and logistics firms through hardware plus subscription software. Founded in 1978 and listed on Nasdaq (TRMB), it employs around 12,000 people and earns about 3.5 billion dollars of annual revenue. In 2024 it moved its agriculture business into a joint venture with AGCO. B2B brand with strong industry recognition but low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Trimble Inc.
wiki.text: Trimble Inc. is an American software, hardware, and services technology company that was founded in 1978. Its headquarters is in Westminster, Colorado. It is publicly traded on the Nasdaq and listed on the S&P 500. Trimble develops hardware and software for a variety of business sectors including architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC); surveying, mapping, and geomatics (geospatial); and transportation and logistics (T&L).

about: Singapore-based agribusiness group, among Asia's largest, processing and trading palm oil, edible oils, sugar, rice, flour and oilseeds, with plantations in Indonesia and Malaysia and refineries across China, India and Africa. It sells to consumers under Fortune cooking oil in China and brands such as Arawana, and to food manufacturers. Revenue is about 65 billion dollars. Listed on the SGX (F34) and founded in 1991 by Kuok Khoon Hong and Martua Sitorus. Strong consumer brands in Asia.

wiki.title: Wilmar International
wiki.text: Wilmar International Limited (simplified Chinese: 丰益国际; traditional Chinese: 豐益國際; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Hong-ek Kok-chè) is a Singaporean food processing and investment holding company with more than 300 subsidiary companies. Founded in 1991, it is one of Asia's leading agribusiness groups alongside the COFCO Group. It ranks amongst the largest listed companies by market capitalisation on the Singapore Exchange (SGX), being the second largest as of September 2010.
